correctness.rationale: The exact 48-fold ordered-octant sphere chart and Jacobian give f_{M,S}=12/(pi sqrt(2(1-m^2)-(s-m)^2)) on the exact explicitly established support. The t-angle substitution proves normalization and conditional distribution. Running the packaged checker verifies independent moments and four direct spherical simulations, but those finite checks are not substituted for the derivation.

A generic spherical-coordinate density is a sufficient starting ingredient for the proof but has not been located as an already-evaluated joint width law. A published all-mixed-moment identity or angular pushforward formula could potentially subsume the statement; searches did not identify one.

value.rationale: The exact copula of cube and octahedron half-widths under a shared normal is not determined by prior scalar marginals and covariance. The complete natural two-body law has a sharp geometric boundary change at m=1/sqrt(2), plus an explicit conditional sampling rule uniform on a fixed angular interval above the threshold; this is structurally meaningful rather than a table increment.
